title: TikTok Series Continuity Planner — Next Script
description: Send past scripts, captions, or a plain summary of your series so far, and get a complete next-episode script that stays consistent and ready to film — with a new-viewer recap, callbacks for loyal viewers, a cliffhanger built only on established facts, and a continuity ledger. Anything not established is marked for confirmation, never invented.

skills.name: tiktok-series-continuity-planner
skills.purpose: Turn a creator's pasted series premise, prior episode notes, and approved facts into a cohesive next-episode plan and production-ready script.
